messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: AUTOMATED PAGE — p99 latency breach detected for service=redwood-inference-api region=eu-west-1. p99 = 2.8s (threshold 2.0s) over 5m window. PagerDuty incident INC-6721 created and notified oncall.

pagerduty: PagerDuty — Incident INC-6721 triggered and paged to oncall schedule. Escalation path enabled. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-6721

maria: acking — I'm oncall. I'm seeing the spike in the EU cluster at ~12:42 UTC. Dashboards show request count normal but tail latency jumping, looks like tokenization / cold path. :eyes:

aj: oncall standby — I can help with cache warming and autoscaler checks. Any obvious increase in batch size?

dan-sre: jumping in — saw similar yesterday when a small rollout increased average seq len. Maria, can you grab a few runtime logs for tokenizer and sidecar timeouts? Also check autoscaler backlog and GPU queue depth.

maria: tails from inference-runtime (filtered) — pasted:```
2026-03-15T12:41:57Z inference-runtime[svc] INFO request_id=abc123 seq_len=1024 stage=tokenize duration_ms=1320
2026-03-15T12:41:58Z inference-runtime[svc] WARN request_id=def456 seq_len=48 stage=kv_cache_lookup duration_ms=15
2026-03-15T12:42:01Z inference-runtime[svc] INFO request_id=ghi789 seq_len=1200 stage=tokenize duration_ms=1890
2026-03-15T12:42:05Z inference-runtime[svc] ERROR request_id=jkl012 stage=sidecar_write timeout_ms=5000
```
maria: looks like a cluster of long tokenization durations; not a full outage but pushes p99 up. No obvious 5xx spike.

aj: checked HPA and dedicated pool metrics: autoscaler didn't spin up in time — target pods=4 current pods=4, cpu not high but GPU queue depth = 45. There are a couple of hot tokens. Might be KV-cache cold misses.

dan-sre: runbook step 2: trigger manual scale on dedicated pool and enable cache warm. Commands:```
# manual scale up
kubectl -n inference scale deployment inference-eu-dedicated --replicas=6
# kick prewarm job
kubectl -n inference create job kv-cache-warm-20260315 --image=redwood/kv-warm:stable -- /scripts/warm --prefixes recent-requests
```

maria: running scale now. Will also add a temporary routing rule to divert heavy sequences to the beefy pool.

incident-bot: Autoscaler action: manual_scale invoked by maria — desired_replicas=6. Allocation in progress.

maria: routing rule applied to send model=redwood-7b-long to inference-eu-dedicated. Prewarm job submitted.

aj: prewarm job logs show warming keys ~ 75% after 20s. GPU allocation +2 acknowledged by cluster scheduler.

incident-bot: Metric update: p99 reduced from 2.8s -> 1.4s within 70s of scale/prewarm. Current p95=0.42s p99=1.4s.

dan-sre: good improvement. Will keep watch for 10m. We should consider a throttling policy for sequences > 1024 tokens while we stabilize.

maria: incident acknowledged in PagerDuty (INC-6721) and suppressed escalation. Adding post-incident ticket INF-889 to track follow-ups: KV cache LRU tuning, autoscaler burst config, routing guardrails. :white_check_mark:

aj: leaving a quick note: possible root cause = sudden increase in long-sequence requests from a customer A/B test hitting long-context model. We'll follow up with product/solutions.

dan-sre: handoff to followup rotation in 2h — if p99 holds <1.5s for 15m we'll resolve. Creating a short post-incident checklist now.

maria: thanks all — moving to monitoring and will update once stable. :thumbsup:
